where: verify/bs-catalog.js FILTER kinds reference and boarding-actions; staticHidden listChoice
why:
Each kind checked on the pin:
- other-mode: the 4 detachments it drops (Tyranid Attack, Boarding Swarm, Biotide, Infestation Swarm) are each hidden only by “notInstanceOf Boarding Actions” (force scope).
- reference: the 4 New Recruit copies (Spore Mines (Biovore)/(Harpy), Ripper Swarms (Parasite), Mucolid Spores (Sporocyst)), each also a root datasheet.
- staticHidden with listChoice changes exactly these rows: Lictor, Deathleaper and Neurolictor lose Deep Strike (GW prints none under CORE ABILITIES; it is Ambush Predators’ Mindhunger, faction page line 542); Norn Emissary and Assimilator lose Protean Purpose (Talons of the Norn Queen); Custodes Knight-Centura loses its Warlord option; Daemons Stealth is the other reviewer’s. All right for Tyranids and Custodes.
Notes:
- listChoice takes every id nested anywhere under an Enhancements group, the Detachment entry or Warlord, targetIds included. A profile shared by an enhancement and a datasheet option would count as a list’s choice; I found no such case.
- MODE_FORCES is a module-level cache filled from the first game system loaded; fine while there is one game system.

where: verify/deviations-bsdata.json army "catalog", tyranids (123, written mechanically with GW evidence)
why:
Spot-checked 35 of 123 against the Wahapedia pages, the Event Companion and Faction Pack 1.3; all GW’s:
- Keywords: The Red Terror, Mawloc and Trygon BURROWER; Tyrannocyte, Toxicrene and Tyrannofex FRAME; Biovores and Ripper Swarms names.
- Core abilities: Scouts 8" (Broodlord, Genestealers); Stealth dropped (Gargoyles, both Warriors, Genestealers, Raveners: none under GW’s CORE ABILITIES); Feel No Pain 5+ (Old One Eye, Psychophage); Deadly Demise values (D3, D6, 1, 2D6 on Harridan and Hierophant).
- Other: Toxicrene’s Damaged dropped (GW prints none); Sporocyst HIVE DEFENCES weapon keyword dropped; Unnatural Resilience; Leader lists; Gargoyles “Small Flying” base (guide line 3814); the 17 points declarations.
Note: Hyperadapted Raveners’ Rules line drops Sustained Hits, which Alpha Invader grants to all its weapons, so the glossary lacks it on that row.

The declaration is accurate; it stays the owner’s question. GW’s 11th-edition Core Rules (17.02) give FRAME to base-less models “as do some other large models”, without a list. Wahapedia’s 11th datasheets print FRAME on Tyrannofex, Toxicrene and Tyrannocyte, and Faction Pack 1.3’s Imperial Armour sheets on Hierophant and Hierodules; BSData and the pack’s keyword updates don’t. Recommendation: FRAME on the list row too. The catalogue already takes Wahapedia’s FRAME for Toxicrene and Tyrannocyte, so leaving only the Tyrannofex without it is the inconsistent choice.
GW: CORE ABILITIES “Deadly Demise D6” only; Unnatural Resilience “Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds”. The catalogue is right; the lists’ signed row keeps New Recruit’s, declared.

Three needs misreads.
- Questing Tendrils gets {rule:[Questing Tendrils]} (“units with this ability”), but no unit’s Rules line names it, so the rule reaches nobody. GW: “TYRANIDS units with this ability are eligible to charge in a turn in which they Fell Back. VANGUARD INVADER units … Advanced.” It is the detachment rule for TYRANIDS units, a keyword is named, and derive.js’s own with-this-ability rule is for no keyword.
- Hypersensory Scillia: TARGET “Up to two VANGUARD INVADER units … or one other TYRANIDS INFANTRY unit”.
- Invisible Hunter: “Up to two VANGUARD INVADER units …, or one TYRANIDS INFANTRY unit”.
Both give {all:[Vanguard Invader]}, dropping the “or one other TYRANIDS INFANTRY” alternative; Invasion Fleet’s “or one other TYRANIDS unit” is read right. Program-made label: the correction belongs in derive.js (for the labels list), not a hand label.
Leader-beasts: keyword/BATTLELINE/InSv grants with no phase, needs the Warrior/Prime datasheets; the three stratagems match their WHEN/TARGET (the TYRANID WARRIORS keyword comes from Leader-beasts).

Surprise Assault: phases right (re-rolls of hit rolls of 1, tunnel markers). needs any[Faction: Tyranids, Mawloc, Trygon] equals all Tyranids (the extra names are redundant, harmless). Stratagems right.

Mindhunger (Deep Strike grant, re-rolls vs CHARACTER) needs any[Deathleaper, Lictor, Neurolictor]; Counterpredation fight, Hypersensory Adaptations your Shooting, Scanner Gheist end of opponent’s Fight, with Von Ryan’s Leapers where GW names them.
